video.title: Re-Ranking The 2026 NBA Draft Class | Dynasty Rookie Ranks

summary: Josh Lloyd re-ranks his top 43 dynasty rookies by tier after Summer League. He says you should not overreact to Summer League, but you should still make some moves, so most changes are small one or two spot shifts. Risers include Emanuel Sharp, Trevon Brazile, Ryan Conwell, Sergio de Larrea, Yaxel Lendeborg, Morez Johnson Jr. and Allen Graves. Fallers include Jayden Quaintance (another knee surgery), Bennett Stirtz, Dailyn Swain and Aday Mara. The top four stay in tier one: Cameron Boozer at 1, Darryn Peterson at 2, Caleb Wilson at 3 and AJ Dybantsa at 4. He also flags Darius Acuff Jr. as a bust risk.

rules.text: Do not overreact to Summer League, but still react with some ranking moves.
rules.quote: it's important not to overreact to summer league. I think you all know that. But you should react.

rules.text: Older prospects who miss their rookie year to injury get bumped down.
rules.quote: I'm an older player, missing his first year, so I bumped him down.

rules.text: How soon a player can earn a role matters in dynasty rookie rankings. A great prospect in a crowded rotation gets ranked lower.
rules.quote: part of it is where is the immediiacy in role and it's not there.

rules.text: Summer League production from Lakers players tends to be overrated.
rules.quote: it was also, as happens to Lakers players, overrated because you

rules.text: Older rookies are not more NBA ready, but they reach their peak sooner. That makes them more useful for older, contending dynasty teams.
rules.quote: the fact that he is 24 means he will hit his peak sooner.

rules.text: Three-point attempt volume is the most translatable Summer League stat for rookies. Shooting percentages are not.
rules.quote: the most translatable part of some league stats for rookies is what his volume was shooting.

rules.text: Players in the same tier are close to interchangeable. Pick between them based on your own team.
rules.quote: this is where you have to look at these things and look at tiers and look at ranks and look at your team.

rules.text: Even strong draft classes have two or three top-10 picks who bust badly.
rules.quote: Somebody in the top five, two or three players in the top 10 are going to bust terribly.
